prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 30s goddess, black glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, waist-length braids golden blonde hair — her bare skin covered from the neck down in a black-and-white darkroom silver print: rich deep blacks, bright whites and fine silvery grain across her torso, arms and legs, an image of misty dunes and rippling water with dodged and burned tonal shading, white film-rebate border marks and tiny frame numbers at the edges, the print sitting on living skin and following every curve beneath it, covering all of her skin from the neck to the ankles and the backs of her hands, her face left unpainted and the pattern fading out at the neck. Her face, ears, neck and hands are real living skin with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs, a soft natural flush. Pose: standing perfectly upright and tall in a pointe stance with both legs pressed together and arms relaxed at her sides, looking straight at the camera — most extreme black glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of polished soft-black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy soft-black polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.

Background: a sunny city plaza of light paving with a low fountain edge, a street lamp and standard-height shop doors behind her, lit by natural light with soft shadows on the skin, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
